name: agent-polygraph-live-agent
description: Real Bitget Agent Hub trading component: market state -> decision -> risk check -> paper order -> execution result -> persistent log. Separate from the Python Polygraph crash-test harness by design (different data source).

scripts.mock: npm run build && node lib/agent.js --mode mock
scripts.paper: npm run build && node lib/agent.js --mode paper
scripts.mock:futures: npm run build && node lib/futures/agent.js --mode mock
scripts.paper:futures: npm run build && node lib/futures/agent.js --mode paper
scripts.test:all: npm run build && node --test lib/futures/*.test.js lib/polygraph/*.test.js
